name: io.github.rafe-walker/sea-lite
description: Work queue for parallel coding agents: leased path-scoped claims, typed links, hash-chained history

environmentVariables.name: KRONICLE_LITE_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of the shared SQLite store (default ~/.kronicle-lite)

environmentVariables.name: SEA_LITE_ACTOR
environmentVariables.description: Actor label used on claims and writes (default local-agent)

environmentVariables.name: SEA_LITE_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: agent (default) or operator; operator unlocks force release

environmentVariables.name: SEA_LITE_TRACKS
environmentVariables.description: Enabled lifecycle tracks, e.g. work,design (default work)
